description:
A local mercenary, handy
with a dagger and 
morally flexible.  If the
job pays well, Gustav is
in.  He hopes to recieve
a royal pardon for his
extensive criminal record
by assisting you.

Don't let his age fool
you, Bromswell was an
adventurer in his day,
and a wizened master of 
the arcane arts.  While
technically retired, he's
still willing to lend his
skill to a worthy cause.

A traveler from the far
north, frost still clinging
to his beard, pelts and
scars adorn him.  His
weathered blades and
wildly gleaming eyes
speak of countless foes
slain...

An enigmatic sorceress,
distrusted by the locals.
Some believe she traded
her soul for the secrets
of dark magic.  Rumors
they may be, she is no
doubt a powerful
practitioner of forbidden
arts.

Member of an ancient
order from a distant
land. Their purpose - to
protect the innocent, and
hone both body and
spirit into the ultimate
weapon.  Evil creatures
flee at the sight of his
righteous fist!

A traveling minstrel who
inspires courage in all
who hear his music.  It
is said he was once a
Prince, but fate robbed
him of both his kingdom,
and his one true love.
He fights so that others
will not suffer as he has.

The only daughter of a
wealthy local merchant.  
To escape an arranged
marriage, she has fled
from her life of luxury
to pursue adventure,
and study the unladylike
art of combat.

An elven sorceress
hailing from the distant
southlands.  Her people
are both respected and
feared in these parts,
due in part to their
incomprehensible accent,
and the fearsome magic
they command.

No one is quite sure 
who he is, or from what
kingdom he hails.  Still,
none doubt his resilience
and strength.  There are
rumors that he once
survived having all of
his limbs dismembered.

A notorious pirate, he
once ruled the waters
of Doomvale until his
ship was destroyed by a
rampaging ninja.  He
hopes to one day exact
his revenge.

While his skills with a
bow are unparalleled,
he is perhaps the laziest
adventurer in all of
Haggerdom.  He was
supposed to be helping
the party months ago,
but apparently had
overslept.

A holy warrior who
combines healing magic
with impressive defense.
Her temper is short, and
her tongue is as sharp
as her blade... which has
claimed the heads of
countless trolls.
